metadata.rationale: Initiate Payment sits inside the payment-initiation domain's scope
The four stages of Make a Payment correspond to the credit-transfer scenario's four operations
Capture and validation invoke Initiate and Evaluate of the domain
Execution and confirmation invoke Execute and Retrieve of the domain
The bank's Payment Instruction carries the same meaning as the canonical object; 6 of 8 attributes align
Initiate ↔ POST; no qualifier; 8/8 attributes in payload
Evaluate ↔ POST; Validation qualifier in path; 3/3 attributes
Execute ↔ PUT; Execution qualifier in path; 3/3 attributes
Retrieve implemented as POST (legacy channel constraint, ADR-PAY-017) — approved with a recorded deviation from the REST mapping
Update ↔ PATCH; 4/4 attributes
The hub implements five of the domain's six operations through Payments API v2
8/8 canonical attributes present in the hub table; channel_id is an extension
Production hosting
Production deployment of the hub
UAT deployment of the hub
The execution gateway is deployed separately on the production cluster
Production deployment of the gateway
UAT hosting of the hub; DEPLOYED_ON is environment-agnostic, the environment is on DEP-PAYHUB-UAT (added after M1: the CMDB and the UAT deployment both state it)
Payments API v2 is reached from the internet through the managed API gateway in the security zone (DMZ) (made up).
The Payments Hub 7.1 is built as the container image payments-hub:7.1 by its build pipeline (made up).
